name: nexusmart
description: NexusMart - sàn thương mại điện tử đa nhà bán tích hợp trợ lý AI

scripts.setup: npm run env:init && npm run install:all
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix crm install && npm --prefix crm/crm-ui install
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d mongodb postgres keycloak
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,store,crm,crm-ui -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:crm" "npm run dev:crm-ui"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix crm/crm-ui run build
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start" "npm --prefix crm start"
scripts.clean-start: npm run kill-ports && npm run dev

author: NexusMart Team
